function: TD3 agent sets STAR-RIS phase shifts and reflection/transmission time fractions jointly with offloading ratio and transmission time; CPU frequencies and powers are derived analytically (p. 8).
system: Single-cell NOMA uplink with M UEs; STAR-RIS of N elements, time-switching mode (4-24 tested); antennas and carrier frequency not stated; bandwidth 1 MHz (p. 3-4, 10, 13).
method: TD3 reinforcement learning (twin critics, two 256-neuron hidden layers, up to 15,000 episodes) with analytic KKT solutions for CPU frequency and power embedded (p. 8-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rician fading factor 10, path-loss exponents 2, 2.5 and 4, UEs uniform in two 50 m regions; no dataset or measurement (p. 10).
test_conditions: Training by interaction with one simulated cell; energy swept over slot length, data size, number of UEs (1-6) and STAR-RIS elements (4-24); no unseen-condition test stated (p. 12-13).
baselines: Learned: DB-DDPG, pure TD3 without decomposition. Non-learned: local computing (LC), random allocation (RA); system variants NOMA with conventional RIS, without RIS, TDMA with STAR-RIS (p. 10-13).
metrics: Average energy consumption of UEs and MEC server, mean reward, convergence episodes, percentage energy reduction versus baselines (p. 10-13).
complexity: Big-O of actor and critics, G1 and C1; total training O(GammaXT((2G1+2C1)+3M)); execution O(G1+3M); no runtime reported (p. 10).
q1_support: p. 10: "with a Rician fading factor of 10" - custom Rician simulator with chosen path-loss exponents (2, 2.5, 4); no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 14: "its scenario-specific assumptions and limited generalization" - the paper only sweeps slot length, data size, number of UEs and STAR-RIS elements (pp. 12-13) and never tests a trained model in a new scenario.
q3_support: p. 13: "Compared to DB-DDPG, LC, and RA, the DB-TD3" - energy reductions are reported; p. 12: "The LC method processes all computational" - LC and RA are non-learned, DB-DDPG is the learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 10: "complexity of O(G1 + 3M )" - execution complexity, with the total training complexity O(GammaXT((2G1+2C1)+3M)) in Section IV-C.
q5_support: p. 10: "In the considered scenario, UEs are uniformly distributed" - self-generated simulation; no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: Included under rule 4: the learned TD3 action A(t) = {l_m, lambda1, theta1_n, theta2_n, d_off} (p. 8) holds the physical-layer STAR-RIS configuration (area 3) jointly with the offloading ratio (above PHY); CPU frequencies and transmit power are analytic (Section III). q3 counts DB-DDPG as a standard learned baseline (DDPG with the same decomposition); pure TD3 (Fig. 7) and the alternative state (Fig. 8) are ablations and are not counted. Perfect CSI is assumed (p. 4).
